_설명: 고니감독님 요청(2026-10-13): 倉庫番 썸네일(「地獄を見せてやる」)과 같은 애니메이션 형식을 선명하게 — 고해상도 2560x1440 생성(seedream v4 edit). 구도는 참고와 동일: 왼쪽 서류를 안은 여성(글자가 몸 위에 겹침) · 가운데~오른쪽 무릎 꿇은 악역(스포트라이트) · 맨 오른쪽 서서 내려다보는 남자 · 뒤쪽 놀란 직원들. 글자는 로컬 합성. 후보 4장.
_style_preset: Semi-realistic Japanese webtoon illustration, crisp bold ink outlines, detailed cel shading, ultra sharp, 16:9

characters.prompt: Create ONE single ultra-sharp, highly detailed illustration in 16:9 widescreen for a YouTube thumbnail — one image only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders. Art style exactly like reference image 4 but cleaner and sharper: semi-realistic Japanese webtoon / drama-manga illustration, crisp bold black ink outlines on every figure, detailed cel shading with soft gradients, glossy highlights, rich saturated colors, strong rim light, every face crisp and in focus (no blur on the main characters). Setting: a large power-plant control room right after a blackout, lit by red emergency lamps on the walls and two bright white spotlight beams falling from the ceiling, glossy floor reflecting the red light, banks of dark consoles with BLANK screens; in the background a crowd of office workers in dark suits watching in shock (softly out of focus). Composition (keep exactly): LEFT THIRD of the frame — the young woman from reference image 3 (black bob with bangs, light-blue work uniform, no glasses, no earrings), seen from the waist up and turned three-quarters toward the viewer, her face at about one third from the left edge and in the upper half of the frame, hugging a thick stack of documents to her chest with both arms, determined eyes glistening with tears. CENTER-RIGHT, in the spotlight on the floor — the young manager from reference image 1 (light-brown upswept two-block hair, glossy navy three-piece suit, thick gold wristwatch) fallen to his knees, one hand on the floor and the other hand raised and trembling, sweat drops on his face, eyes wide, mouth open in panic. FAR RIGHT, standing tall at full height and looking down at him coldly — the older man from reference image 2 (grey-streaked short hair, silver rectangular glasses, small scar above the left eyebrow, charcoal suit, grey tie), slightly low angle so he looks powerful. Faces must clearly resemble the reference people; correct anatomy, five fingers per hand, symmetrical eyes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signs or symbols anywhere — screens and papers are blank.
